the husbandry factors in this study did not influence the resumption of cyclicity.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the resumption of luteral activity was not affected by husbandry factors.
dairy cows in open and zero-grazing systems, irrespective of feed supplements, have a high probability of resuming normal luteal activity after calving.
the resumption of postpartum cyclicity is influenced by parity and the husbandry factors, but the resumption of normal cyclicity is influenced only by parity.

, although the majority of cows in urban and per-urban dairy farming systems in Uganda resume cyclicity normally, only a minority of cows maintain regular cycling.
